# Labster

> Labster provides immersive virtual lab simulations for STEM education across biology, chemistry, physics, and health sciences with LMS integration and curriculum alignment.

Labster offers award-winning 3D virtual laboratory experiences designed for universities and high schools, featuring interactive simulations aligned to NGSS, AP standards, and major learning management systems like Canvas, Blackboard, and Moodle. The platform combines immersive learning technology with automated grading, data analytics, and research-backed outcomes for improved student retention and engagement.

## Virtual Lab Simulations & Catalog

- [Virtual Lab Simulation Catalog](https://www.labster.com/simulations): Award-winning virtual lab catalog in Biology, Chemistry, Physics with course matching and curriculum alignment.
- [Find a Course | Browse Our Virtual Lab Catalog by Course](https://www.labster.com/simulation-courses): Labster virtual labs organized by course in Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and Health Sciences.
- [Find a Collection | Browse Our Virtual Lab Catalog by Collection](https://www.labster.com/collections): Labster virtual lab collections for curriculum mapping and subscription-based access.
- [Virtual Labs Aligned to Science Skills](https://www.labster.com/simulation-skills): Labster labs matched to NGSS, ACS, and AAPT science skill frameworks and standards.

## Discipline-Specific Labs

- [Biology](https://www.labster.com/discipline/biology): Labster biology virtual labs for gateway courses aligned to NGSS and AP standards.
- [Chemistry](https://www.labster.com/discipline/chemistry): Labster chemistry simulations including AP Chemistry and General Chemistry courses.
- [Physics](https://www.labster.com/discipline/physics): Labster physics virtual labs covering mechanics, electromagnetism, and AP Physics.
- [Health Sciences](https://www.labster.com/discipline/health-sciences): Labster health sciences labs in anatomy, physiology, and microbiology for higher ed.
- [3D Chemistry Models](https://www.labster.com/3d): Interactive 3D molecular models for chemistry visualization and augmented reality learning.

- [Impact | Labster Enhances STEM Outcomes](https://www.labster.com/impact): Research-backed impact data on Labster's effect on retention, test scores, and engagement.

## Case Studies & Research

- [Teaching Community College Chemistry Where Graduation Isn't Guaranteed](https://www.labster.com/case-studies/teaching-chemistry-community-college): Case study of Phil Silverman's use of Labster virtual labs at State Fair Community College.
- [How Labster Enhanced Learning in Veterinary Science Education](https://www.labster.com/research/enhanced-learning-in-veterinary-science): Research study on Labster's effectiveness for veterinary immunology education at University of Extremadura.
